beats.intro: Derivatives, module five. [[sub]]Price and value are different things. This chapter prices and values forwards, starting from equities and currencies, and ending with interest rates.
beats.value: [[a]]Pricing and valuation answer different questions. The forward price is the fixed price agreed at the start. It is set so that the contract has a value of zero for both sides. [[val]]The value then changes as the spot price moves and time passes. At maturity, the long's value is the spot price minus the forward price. [[ex]]Viswan Family Office agrees to sell Biomian shares forward at three hundred rupees and eighty-four paise. [[s1]]If the spot price ends at two hundred eighty-seven, the buyer loses thirteen eighty-four per share, and the seller gains the same amount. [[s2]]If it ends at three hundred twelve, the buyer gains eleven sixteen, and the seller loses it. [[pt]]One side's gain is always the other side's loss.
beats.midlife: [[a]]During the life of the contract, the long's value is the current spot price, minus the present value of the forward price, discounted at the risk-free rate for the time remaining. The seller's value is the opposite. [[imp]]For Biomian, the spot price is two ninety-five, and the forward price is three hundred rupees and eighty-four paise. That implies a four percent rate. [[jump]]If the spot price jumped to three twenty-five at the start, the seller would be down thirty rupees. [[t1]]Now take three months in. The spot price falls to two eighty-five, while the present value of the forward price is two ninety-seven ninety. The seller is ahead by twelve ninety. [[t2]]If the rate doubles to eight percent, the present value of the forward price drops, and the seller's gain shrinks to ten eleven.
beats.carry: [[a]]With income or costs on the asset, the value adjusts. The long's value is the spot price, minus the present value of remaining income, plus the present value of remaining costs, minus the present value of the forward price. [[ex]]Hightest holds a forward on Unilever at fifty euros sixty-three. Four months in, one dividend of thirty cents remains, worth twenty-nine point seven six cents today. [[pv]]The forward price, discounted for two months, is fifty twenty-two. [[be]]So the contract is worth zero when the spot price is fifty twenty-two plus thirty cents: fifty euros fifty-one seven eight.
beats.fx: [[a]]A currency forward is valued the same way, using the gap between the two interest rates. The value is the spot rate, minus the forward rate discounted at the rate difference. [[ex]]Rook Point has agreed to buy a million euros for one million two hundred one thousand dollars in a year. Spot is one point one nine two. Rates are half a percent in dollars, and negative a quarter percent in euros. [[up]]Right after the trade, the dollar rate rises by a quarter point. The rate gap widens, so the discounted forward rate falls to one point one eight nine oh five oh. [[res]]Compared with spot, that is a gain of two thousand nine hundred fifty dollars and fifteen cents.
beats.zero: [[a]]For interest rates, one rate does not fit all maturities. Each maturity has its own zero rate, the yield on a single cash flow. Zero rates are bootstrapped from coupon bonds. [[t]]Take three government bonds, paying one point five, two point five, and three point two five percent. [[z1]]The one-year bond has one cash flow, so its zero rate is simply two point three nine six percent. [[z2]]Use that rate to discount the first coupon of the two-year bond, then solve for the second zero rate: three point four one nine seven percent. [[z3]]Repeat once more, for four point oh oh oh five percent. [[df]]The price of a unit of currency in the future is a discount factor: one over one plus the zero rate, to the power of the number of years.
beats.ifr: [[a]]An implied forward rate is the breakeven reinvestment rate between two zero-coupon bonds. [[p1]]One hundred invested for two years at the two-year zero rate grows to one hundred six ninety-six. [[p2]]The other way is one year at the one-year rate, then one more year at the forward rate. [[eq]]Setting the two equal, one plus the one-year rate, times one plus the forward rate, equals one plus the two-year rate, squared. [[res]]The forward rate, one year from now for one year, is four point four five three six percent. [[gen]]In general, the A-period zero compounded with the forward rate equals the B-period zero. The one-year rate in two years comes out at five point one seven one nine percent.
beats.mrr: [[a]]The same idea works for short-term reference rates. The three-month rate is one point two five percent, and the six-month rate is one point seven five percent. [[conv]]First, put both on the same basis. The semiannual one point seven five percent equals one point seven four six one nine percent quarterly. [[solve]]Then solve: one plus the three-month rate over four, times one plus the forward over four, equals one plus the converted six-month rate over four, squared. [[res]]The three-month rate, three months from now, is two point two four two nine nine percent. [[chk]]Check: a hundred million yuan earns the same one hundred million eight hundred seventy-five thousand either way.
beats.fra: [[a]]A forward rate agreement fixes a rate for a future period. The buyer pays a fixed rate, and receives the market reference rate. [[ex]]Yangzi Bank agrees to pay two point two four two nine nine percent on a hundred million yuan, for three months starting in three months. [[set]]In three months, the reference rate sets at two point one five percent, lower than the fixed rate. [[net]]The net payment is negative twenty-three thousand two hundred forty-seven fifty, ninety days after the start. [[pv]]But an FRA settles at the beginning of the period, so the amount is discounted at the reference rate, to negative twenty-three thousand one hundred twenty-three twenty-one. [[pt]]The bank's loss on the FRA is offset by a lower payment on the liability it hedges.
beats.wrap: [[w1]]A forward starts at zero value. Its price is fixed, but its value changes. [[w2]]Value is the spot price, adjusted for income and costs, minus the present value of the forward price. [[w3]]Zero rates are bootstrapped from coupon bonds, and discount factors price future cash flows. [[w4]]Implied forward rates link zero rates, and a forward rate agreement locks one in.
beats.finish: Module five complete. Next: pricing and valuing futures contracts.
